title: Slot-aware latency smoothing and kernel lane consolidation for embeddings endpoint
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Reduce p99 tail for the vector embeddings endpoint across multi-tenant hosts while preserving overall throughput. Hypothesis: introducing a slot-aware micro-batching layer that groups requests by effective compute lane (sequence length/quantization path) plus a kernel lane consolidation pass will reduce straggler variance without degrading CPU/GPU utilization. Workstreams: 1) ingress slot classifier and slot queues, 2) coordinator that forms micro-batches by slot with a soft wait policy, 3) kernel lane consolidation that biases kernel selection to stable fast paths for short sequences, 4) observability and guardrails (per-tenant SLOs, fail-open policy).
acceptance_criteria: p99 for embeddings endpoint (served on vpc-emb-prod) reduced by >=30% in steady-state traffic patterns compared to baseline within 2 weeks of rollout
no >5% regression in overall tokens/sec throughput on affected hosts during experiments
feature gated rollout control in console with canary at 10/30/100% and automatic rollback on SLO breach
end-to-end tests and perf harness added to ci/perf to validate slot packing correctness
concurrent requests from different tenants do not experience starvation; documented fairness bounds
technical_notes: Slot definition: compact bucket of (seq_len_bucket, model_variant, quant_path) used for fast heuristic routing
Soft wait policy: maximum wait 8ms or until batch size target achieved; adaptive target based on observed latency distribution
Kernel lane consolidation: when two kernels produce statistically indistinguishable latencies for a slot, prefer the lower-variance kernel to reduce tail; fallback maintained
Memory impact: per-slot KV cache tracking will add ~1.5% memory overhead on 80GB GPUs in tests, accounted in capacity planning
Edge case: long-seq requests (>1024) bypass slot queue and use dedicated long-run path to avoid blocking fast lanes
experiments: Local perf harness: synthetic mix with 70% short (<=64) sequences, 25% mid (65-512), 5% long (>512); observed baseline p99 810ms
Slot-aware scheduler (no kernel consolidation): p99 reduced to 520ms, median unchanged; throughput -1.2%
Add kernel lane consolidation heuristics: p99 reduced further to 420ms; throughput -2.8% as measured in scale lab (8-host cluster)
A/B canary on staging: 10% traffic for 24h, tied to runtime-1.22 build with feature flag; saw 35% p99 reduction for tenants dominated by short sequences, minimal impact on long-seq tenants
Observed regression: cold-cache miss rate increased for rare model_variant+quant_path combos; mitigation: add probabilistic prewarm for slots with >0.1% observed frequency
rollout_plan: Stage 0: internal perf lab validation and automated regression suite (done)
Stage 1: canary 10% traffic (runtime flag), monitor p99 and errors for 24h
Stage 2: expand to 30% for 48h if no regressions; verify downstream metrics and dashboards
Stage 3: 100% in affected region with automatic rollback rules (p99 > baseline*0.85 or >0.5% error increase) and manual sign-off
Stage 4: Post-rollout 7-day review and capacity tuning; schedule follow-up for embeddings reranker how-to docs
